text:
Situation: Fentanyl citrate injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2012-01-01 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 6.9 days of supply across three presentations. Corvale General holds 18 days across three lots. Corvale Lakeside holds 17.3 days of one presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2012-01-01. The Hospira, Inc. plant (FEI 1021343) supplying Corvale East and Corvale General received an OAI classification on 2010-01-19, a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12, and two additional OAI inspections ending 2011-06-17 and 2011-08-04. The Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. plant (FEI 2220525) supplying Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside has only VAI inspections, most recent ending 2024-06-12.

Our position: Corvale East is critically low. Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside have sufficient inventory to support limited transfers while maintaining two-week minimums. Alternate sourcing from manufacturers not on the FDA shortage list is viable. An alternate Hikma presentation is pre-approved for pharmacist verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 231 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by Pharmacy Director.
2. Transfer 17 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by Pharmacy Director.
3. Purchase from Civica, Inc. — approved by Buyer.
4. Purchase from Phlow Corp. — approved by Buyer.
5. Dispense Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. 50 mcg/mL alternate presentation with pharmacist verification — approved by Pharmacist (pre-approved by Casey Nguyen, MD on 2026-02-28).

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
